verses.pali: “Amataṁ tesaṁ, bhikkhave, aparibhuttaṁ yesaṁ kāyagatāsati aparibhuttā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, those who haven’t enjoyed mindfulness of the body haven’t enjoyed freedom from death.

verses.pali: Amataṁ tesaṁ, bhikkhave, paribhuttaṁ yesaṁ kāyagatāsati paribhuttā”ti.
verses.english: Those who have enjoyed mindfulness of the body have enjoyed freedom from death.”
